About the Subverse

Anyone that has written, started writing, or finished a book, game design, or other artistic project has experienced the pain of creative block. I created this subverse as a way for people to post the things they are having trouble with in order to collaborate with other people from around the world. You don't have to have a fully formed work to make a post. You can post for brainstorming purposes to start something as well.

To the people that post: I wish you good luck in your writing endeavors! Please remember to keep a timestamped copy of your submission prior to making the submission. This is for your protection because people are assholes. Also, I would screenshot your post (up to and including title) so that the post can be retrieved if an issue arises.

To the people that comment: Please respect the fact that the poster is trying to create a work of art. Assist the author of the post to the best of your ability, and do not steal the poster's intellectual property. When you comment, you are offering an intellectual gift to the author free of charge.

Love your artist brethren and aid them in their artistic endeavors.

Rules

  1. Constructive criticism and "professional" critiquing is welcome. Flaming and/or harrassing is a ban.
  2. Do not downvote out of spite or because you do not personally like the author's work.
  3. DO NOT repost someone else's work as your own. This is immediate ban.
  4. Contribute to content discussions via comments before expecting help from the community.
  5. Remember that not everyone believes the same as you do. Keep an open mind and review/aid with complete neutrality.
  6. SOCIAL JUSTICE WARRIORS BEWARE! The world does not fit into your little box. If you waltz into this subverse and push a political agenda (regardless of leaning), promote political correctness, bash any religion, and scream and/or cry about racism and/or intolerance, you can find another place to chill because you will be permabanned.
